name: sim_cvc5_proof_net_correctness_criterion
description: Proof net correctness via Danos-Regnier criterion: correct iff all switchings acyclic and connected. Tests UNSAT when criterion violated.

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/logical computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG not needed; proof net structure encoded as constraint variables

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs

cvc5.reason: load-bearing SMT solver for DR criterion UNSAT proofs

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; proof theory via cvc5/sympy

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; no differential geometry required

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; proof net graph encoded directly in constraints

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; no hypergraph structure

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard logical computations sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology required

test_axiom_perfect_matching.description: Axiom links form perfect matching on literals (each literal A+ paired with A-)

test_switching_with_cycle_unsat.description: A switching with a cycle (3 nodes, 3 edges) violates DR criterion; UNSAT

test_axiom_incomplete_matching_unsat.description: Axiom links incomplete (covers 2 of 4 literals) violates DR criterion; UNSAT

test_sympy_sequentialization.description: Sympy verification: tree property (e=n-1) ensures sequent proof exists
